messages.content: What was the casualty number of the Battle of Waterloo?

message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo saw roughly **50–60 thousand** soldiers involved on both sides, but the actual loss‑figure—those who were killed or seriously wounded—is usually quoted at about **20–22 thousand** combatants:

| Side | Killed + Wounded |
|------|------------------|
| Allies (British, Dutch/Belgian, Prussian) | ≈ 24 000 – 26 000 |
| France & its German allies | ≈ 28 000 – 32 000 |

These totals include men taken prisoner as well. Casualty estimates vary slightly depending on which sources you consult, but most historians settle around those ranges.
